evals.prompt: Create a Python FastAPI middleware that catches all unhandled exceptions, logs the error with traceback and request path, and returns a JSON response with error_id (UUID) and a user-friendly message. Do NOT leak internal exception details. Write tests that verify: (1) a ValueError is caught and returns 500 with error_id, (2) internal exception message is NOT in the response body, (3) the logger was called with the traceback.

evals.prompt: Implement a token-bucket rate limiter in Python using Redis. It should accept a key (e.g. user_id or IP), a capacity (max tokens), and a refill rate (tokens per second). Provide a decorator @rate_limit(key_func, capacity, refill_rate) that can be applied to FastAPI endpoints. Include a test that verifies: (1) requests within capacity succeed, (2) requests exceeding capacity return 429, (3) after waiting for refill, requests succeed again.
evals.expected_output: Token-bucket rate limiter with Redis backend and passing tests
